div.p: Quick answers to the things people ask most.

b:widget-settings.b:widget-setting:
How long does a typical project take?

Landing pages usually take 1–2 weeks; full websites or product designs take 4–8 weeks depending on scope and feedback speed.

What do I need to get started?

Just a short brief: goals, audience, timeline and budget. If you do not have one yet, the discovery call will help us shape it.

Do you offer ongoing support after launch?

Yes. Every project includes a support window, and a monthly partnership is available for continuous improvements.

Can you work with my existing brand or team?

Absolutely. I regularly collaborate with in-house designers, developers and marketers and adapt to your tools and guidelines.

How does payment work?

A 50% deposit starts the project and the balance is due on delivery. Larger projects can be split into milestones.
